title: credit.depleted payload v1
description: A draw took the holder's available balance of a feature from above zero to zero or below ("pack used up"). Made once per crossing. No postings: the draw's own event carries the balance move. Only a draw by the family's own activity makes it: a `track` (a booking's hold) or a `finalize`; never a refund or lost-dispute clawback (`applyBillingPlan`), an edit by hand, or a reset. Judged on the balance after holds: a cancel (`credit.released`) returns the credits with no event and booking again makes it again. atm does not remember that it already alerted: dedupe the notices per holder, feature and grant or cycle. Labelled with `feature`, not `plan`: the balance is the feature's total over every plan.

available.description: The holder's available balance of the feature after the mutation, in the feature's credits.

threshold.description: Always null: running out does not depend on the low-credit threshold.

previous_available.description: The available balance before the mutation (above `available`: these events come from a draw).
